implementation: Fluid gutters, zero-safe grids and bounded desktop reading width.
Compact accessible navigation drawer with inert background, scroll lock, keyboard trap, Escape and rotation cleanup.
Readable stacked forms and dynamic/VisualViewport-aware scrollable dialogs.
Keyboard-focusable table/board scroll regions, reduced tree indentation and wrapping long content.
Stable touch controls, 16px compact input text and preserved normal browser zoom.
Native select layout containment with real rendered long-label and keyboard-selection checks.
Shared Modal captures opener before descendant autofocus and restores only a connected opener.
Photo canvas image lifecycle follows asset/copy revision; pre-paint state reset preserves validation and separate review/approval flow.
limits: Responsive emulation does not exhaust every possible screen/browser/physical keyboard combination.
Physical Android/iPhone use, native layout, browser chrome and safe-area hardware are not certified by this matrix.
Real providers, company UAT, production deployment and all 72 V4 / 475 preserved whole criteria are separate.
Product-completion and V4 business lines were not merged; each responsive PR is based on its own preserved runtime.
Runtime archives/native binaries were not independently downloaded for this design change; the responsive and application evidence ZIPs were downloaded and verified.
